basic_details.job_title: NAM Thrissur Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.official_website: Not provided in the available notice

age_limit.details: Candidates must be not more than 40 years of age.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | pharmacist (homoeopathy): Diploma in Homoeyopathy Pharmacy (CCP) / Certificate Course in Homoeopathic Pharmacy (NCP) or equivalent qualification

salary_details.details: The official notification does not mention any additional allowances.

selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview. If there are 20 or more applicants for the post
a written test will be conducted along with the interview.
how_to_apply: Go through the detailed notification carefully and verify eligibility before applying.
Fill out all relevant fields of the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age, educational qualifications, address, and other required documents.
Place the application and certificates in a sealed envelope.
Super scribe the cover of the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF" (NAME OF THE POST).

Submit the application directly or through post on or before 16 October 2026 to The District Programme Manager, DPMSU, National Ayush Mission, Rama Varma District Ayurveda Hospital Campus, Palace Road, Patturaikkal, Thrissur.
important_instructions: Applications will be accepted only on working days from 10 AM to 5 PM. Applications received after 5 PM on 16/10/2026 will be summarily rejected. Applications through E-mail will not be accepted. Applications submitted in any format other than the format given along with the notification will be rejected. Applications without self-attested copies of certificates will be summarily rejected. If any candidate possesses equivalent qualification, the equivalency certificate must be produced along with the application. Applicants must maintain a personal E-mail ID and Mobile Number active till the completion of the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: National Ayush Mission Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification announces vacancies for the post of Pharmacist (Homoeopathy) on a contract basis in Thrissur district. The exact number of vacancies is stated as "expected" in the official notification.

rows.qualification_required: Diploma in Homoeyopathy Pharmacy (CCP) / Certificate Course in Homoeopathic Pharmacy (NCP) or equivalent qualification

content_sections.heading: National Ayush Mission Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be not more than 40 years of age.

content_sections.heading: National Ayush Mission Salary
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention any additional allowances.

content_sections.heading: National Ayush Mission Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of an interview. If there are 20 or more applicants for the post, a written test will be conducted along with the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for National Ayush Mission Pharmacist
content_sections.text: Go through the detailed notification carefully and verify eligibility before applying. Fill out all relevant fields of the application form. Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age, educational qualifications, address, and other required documents. Place the application and certificates in a sealed envelope. Super scribe the cover of the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF" (NAME OF THE POST). Submit the application directly or through post on or before 16 October 2026 to The District Programme Manager, DPMSU, National Ayush Mission, Rama Varma District Ayurveda Hospital Campus, Palace Road, Patturaikkal, Thrissur.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates proving age Educational qualification certificates Address proof / certificates Equivalency certificate (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: National Ayush Mission Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will be accepted only on working days from 10 AM to 5 PM. Applications received after 5 PM on 16/10/2026 will be summarily rejected. Applications through E-mail will not be accepted. Applications submitted in any format other than the format given along with the notification will be rejected. Applications without self-attested copies of certificates will be summarily rejected. If any candidate possesses equivalent qualification, the equivalency certificate must be produced along with the application. Applicants must maintain a personal E-mail ID and Mobile Number active till the completion of the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation?
faq.answer: National AYUSH Mission, Thrissur District.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name?
faq.answer: Pharmacist (Homoeopathy).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: Vacancies are anticipated or expected, and the exact count is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 16 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Diploma in Homoeopathy Pharmacy (CCP) / Certificate Course in Homoeopathic Pharmacy (NCP) or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: Rs. 14,700/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Offline, by submitting the filled application to the District Programme Manager office either directly or by post.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: 19 October 2026 at 10:30 AM at the National AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager Office, Thrissur.
